# Copilot instructions for AnviOne

Read [docs/HANDOFF.md](../docs/HANDOFF.md) for status and the next plan, and [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) for the project rules. Those rules apply here too.

Key points: build UI from free MIT Untitled UI components via `@anvi/ui`; migrations are forward-only; security and RLS work needs an independent review; audit and outbox rows never carry personal values; AI features stay off; one commit per slice with no attribution lines.
